desc: The SL-SideSaddle USB is a rechargeable hands-free lighting system that is lightweight and compact. It is designed to mount to a wide variety of hats, hard hats and safety helmets, integrating seamlessly without interfering with visors, hearing protection, or other accessories. Featuring two ultra-bright front LED with spot, flood and spot/flood combined beams, as well as a blue rear safety taillight allowing the user to see and be seen for increased safety. Both front and rear lights are programmable for function and output.
